Community Bank decreased its stake in Mcdonalds Corp (MCD) by 14.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Community Bank sold 2,214 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.23% with the market. The institutional investor held 12,601 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.97 million, down from 14,815 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Community Bank who had been investing in Mcdonalds Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $134.49 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.06% or $1.8 during the last trading session, reaching $171.28. About 1.52 million shares traded.
